rationale: Chris brings CTO-level expertise in robotics-simulation with a strong technical foundation (TypeScript, Python, Rust), while Ben is building SF Agents & Robots as a founder focused on robotics-AI. Chris's simulation and systems background complements Ben's product vision, and both are based in San Francisco. This is a natural fit for exploring how simulation infrastructure could power Ben's robotics-AI work.
intro_message: Chris Orlin Cardoza, meet Ben Holfeld — you're both working in robotics in SF, and Chris's simulation and systems expertise could be valuable as Ben scales SF Agents & Robots.
